verdict.rationale: PostHog documents scheduled/recurring data movement — batch exports 'give you a platform to schedule data exports to supported destinations' and the CDP can send data 'in realtime or on a schedule' — plus Workflows for automating multi-step processes triggered by events/person properties. However, none of this is framed as a general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduler exposed to an AI-native user via MCP/CLI (e.g. no evidence of cron-like scheduling of arbitrary agent tasks, skills, or MCP tool calls); the closest AI-agent automation loop (Self-driving/scouts) runs continuously in the background rather than being user-scheduled. Missing for 10: user-facing recurring/cron scheduling of arbitrary AI-agent jobs or MCP tool invocations, and independent confirmation of scheduling reliability.
